_note: Synthetic street-canyon substitute for the paper's large scenes (see scoring/EXPERIMENTS.md). Absolute PSNRs and Gaussian counts are not on the paper's scale; the paper's numbers are kept under _paper_results. Results entries hold the paper's PSNR where the paper reports one; experiments the paper does not report hold this gym's own reference run (seed 0), marked by _results_source.

trajectory_views.description: Held-out views interleaved along the capture trajectory (every 8th frame, paper protocol): rendering quality, resident memory and rasterisation work of a large Gaussian scene.

psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) of the evaluator's renders vs. hidden target images, both quantised to uint8.

loaded_gaussians.description: Mean number of Gaussians resident in memory per view (memory footprint), counted by the evaluator from the submitted resident sets.

visible_gaussians.description: Mean number of resident Gaussians the rasteriser must process per view (in front of the camera, footprint overlapping the image, effective opacity >= 1/255).

peak_loaded_gaussians.description: Diagnostic: maximum resident Gaussians over views (the memory gate uses the maximum over all experiments).

tile_pairs.description: Diagnostic: mean number of Gaussian/16x16-tile intersections per view (rasterisation work).

trajectory_views._results_source: paper Table 3 (SmallCity): Full representation 26.62 dB, Opacity blending (LODGE) 26.57 dB

table3.source: Table 3 (SmallCity performance analysis); Time in ms, #Vis.G and #G as printed

flythrough.description: Dense hidden camera path crossing many resident-set switches: temporal stability of the rendering (no popping) and per-frame quality.

transition_psnr.description: Temporal PSNR of the 5 worst frame-to-frame changes along a dense hidden camera path: rendered change vs. target change (popping/flicker at chunk or level switches). Also a gate: more than 0.5 dB below the full representation fails the run.

psnr.description: Mean PSNR (dB) over the path frames, uint8 protocol.

loaded_gaussians.description: Mean number of Gaussians resident in memory per view (memory footprint), counted by the evaluator from the submitted resident sets.

visible_gaussians.description: Mean number of resident Gaussians the rasteriser must process per view (in front of the camera, footprint overlapping the image, effective opacity >= 1/255).

peak_loaded_gaussians.description: Diagnostic: maximum resident Gaussians over views (the memory gate uses the maximum over all experiments).

flythrough._results_source: Not reported numerically in the paper (Fig. 7 / video show qualitative chunk-boundary artifacts). Values are this gym's hidden-test full representation and reference run (seed 0).

off_path_views.description: Hidden views off the capture trajectory (lateral/height offsets, arbitrary heading): robustness of the reduced representation away from the training camera distribution.

peak_loaded_gaussians.description: Diagnostic: maximum resident Gaussians over views (the memory gate uses the maximum over all experiments).

tile_pairs.description: Diagnostic: mean number of Gaussian/16x16-tile intersections per view (rasterisation work).

off_path_views._results_source: Not reported in the paper (it motivates robustness to cameras outside the training trajectory, supp. A.2). Values are this gym's hidden-test full representation and reference run (seed 0).
